title: Independent-audit R1 corrections to the governed async replan provider — bounded concurrent generation driver, settle/delivery-side stale-generation revalidation, zero-budget admission proof, production-composition integration test (feature flag unchanged, default OFF)
description: Audit R1 on PR #118. F1 — makeReplanGenerationDriver claimed then AWAITED each generation sequentially, and the production replanGenerationBusy flag serialized whole sweeps behind it: one stalled provider call starved every pending row. The driver now claims the whole per-sweep bound UP FRONT (oldest-first fairness; durable CAS lease+epoch remains the single-flight authority) and runs every claimed generation CONCURRENTLY under Promise.all; the busy flag is removed so overlapping sweeps claim newly-minted pending rows while a previous sweep's generations are in flight — each row is claimed once, settle() revalidates before staging so no stale result can land. F2 — settle() now re-proves unresolved-slot, live-recovery-identity and durable-deadline INSIDE its transaction before applying STAGED/FAILED, and requestCandidate() runs the same revalidation at the delivery seam plus a sibling-convergence pass for the bound recovery, committing terminal transitions in their own transaction so a throw can never roll them back — a cancelled, expired, superseded or slot-resolved generation can never become consumable even when reconcile() has not run. F3 — canonical Objective ZERO_BUDGET verified independently at the real admission seam: cap=0 hard-blocks positive envelopes (BUDGET_EXCEEDED) and unprovable UNKNOWN cost (UNVERIFIED), a provable $0 envelope admits CAPPED with a real 0µUSD UNMETERED reservation (bounded, never silently free), absent auto-policy resolves UNCAPPED, no lineage resolves NONE; PR #117 hard-block semantics unchanged. F4 — the two newly-added win32 baselines are narrowed to the exact failing test titles (28 runtime + 1 codex, all secureReadContained/handle-materialization; the 4 passing ingest-adjacent tests stay unmasked), and a production-composition integration test (H1/H2) composes the REAL stack — beginPlannerRun, admitPlannerInvocation, runPlannerFailover, assertPlannerCandidateEligible, canonicalize+validatePlanProposal, planner_run/attempt evidence, finishPlannerRun, settlePlannerInvocation, driver, runtime — with ONLY the model transport stubbed, proven through the atomic commit boundary; synthetic E2E (injected generate) is explicitly separated in sections A–G.
